verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. All four clauses have Lean counterparts, but the first three are not the paper's formulas. (i) D_l: `PhysicalWaveSum.labelRegion D L` is the product of the closed dyadic-mask support with the closed slow-mask support, in the parameter variables (q, x) and indexed by the whole label gamma = (l, a, sigma); the paper's D_l is the (z,t)-support of the band cutoff chi_l(q(z,t)) alone, indexed by the band. Its first factor is the closed band Q_l/2 <= q <= 2 Q_l (`labelRegion_band`, line 249), and the paper's set is reached only after pulling back along `physicalParams h` (q = physicalQ h w) and dropping the slow factor. (ii) L(U): `physical_active_neighborhood` produces a Finset s with I in s iff w lies in D_I, together with a neighbourhood of w in which no further label is active -- which is the paper's L(U) for U small -- but s is a set of labels (band, grid, sign, harmonic), not of bands; the band window actually used downstream is the explicit `CommonWindow.levels n = insert n (Icc (max 1 (n-2)) (n+2))`, shown by `active_level_mem` to contain every active band, i.e. a superset of the paper's L(U) rather than L(U). (iii) i_0: `CommonWindow.index h n` is the same `min` of i(.) but over `levels n`, not over L(U), so the Lean i_0 can be strictly smaller than the paper's -- a coarser common torus, which is still below every active band index (`index_le`) and still within a fixed gap (`gap_le`), so the later argument is unaffected. The one declaration that does state the paper's clause literally, `CommonCoverClass.exists_coarsest_band` (min over a finite set of levels with span <= 4), is not used anywhere else in the repository (grep for its name returns only its own line). (iv) H = pi_{i_0}(Y) is faithful: `commonLift h n d = downLift d . physicalLift h n`, whose Plane component is (cover^(i(n)-d))(Y) by `commonLift_formula`, Y being the universal-cover representative that `nativeGraph` maps to Y_i; the only encoding choice is that the common index enters as the gap parameter d = Delta_l rather than as a minimum. Severity low: the construction the paper wants from (6.17) -- a common index below every band index active near the point, with a bounded gap -- is stated and proved.
